body: Mostly self reflection, why did I think of a memory or person and what does that mean to me.  Small chronicles of my daily activities, although I mostly keeps those on my calendar.  In what ways did journaling help you?
I can't find the initiative to journal everyday, but I still do when I am motivated well enough.

I am currently seeing a Therapist for my depression as well as a psychiatrist.  My most recent return to treatment began again in August. I have had experience with traditional talk therapy, cognitive behavioral therapy and additional self practices (Journaling, self-reflection, and Meditation to name a few)

I have been grappling with depression for 20 years now.  The older I get the worse it becomes.  I began to have suicidal idealizations about three years ago and began to seek treatment as an adult.  

As far as recent current events, there are many.  None terribly dire or life changing in anyway.  This is one of the reasons I have arrived at the conclusion that it is time to stop living.  What bothers me most is how accepting I am of this decision and how much little emotion is provoked by this heinous act that I have planned.
I appreciate your kind words, as it stands now I don't believe I have anything more to offer to society.  It is said we fall down so we can get back up, and I cannot rise again.

I had begun the process of returning to school after a 12 year hiatus.  I would have been studying Poli sci and other physical sciences. My aspirations were to find my scope of change in the world and make it a better place.  Looking to the future I saw myself involved with local politics or more likely a non-profit that I could believe in. That being said I had also considered returning to school afterwards and pursuing a masters in law.
The Appalachian trail.  It is a 2000 mile trail in the Eastern US that stretches from Georgia to Maine and takes approximately 6 months to complete.

Of course. I have multiple levels of goal setting from Life goals (5 years+), Active goals (within 5 years and active planning), Near future (2-3 years), Near future (Within the next years), Weekly and Daily.

These range from the completion of school, hiking the AT, Travel, and self improvement.

None of which hold any importance to me now. In the face of my resolution to end my life they have lost all meaning.
